zh.purpose: 完整控件主题；文本缩放与几何密度独立。通过工厂构造后修改，并调用 validate。

params.font: 全局字体；inherit_font=true 的控件继承它
params.background: View 的背景色；提交帧时须不透明

en.purpose: Complete control theme with independent text scaling and geometry density. Start with a factory, customize and validate.

params.font: global font for controls with inherit_font=true
params.density: geometry scale, 0.5–4.0; does not scale text
params.background: View background; must be opaque when presenting

zh.purpose: 字体配置；空 family 使用系统字体，size 与 line_height 使用逻辑像素。

params.family: UTF-8 字体族名，最多 256 字节且不含 NUL；空值用系统字体
params.size: 基础字号，1–512；缩放后仍须在该范围
params.line_height: 0 使用默认；显式值不小于 size 且不超过 1024

en.purpose: Font configuration. Empty family selects the system font; size and line_height use logical pixels.

params.family: UTF-8 family, at most 256 bytes without NUL; empty selects system font
params.size: base size, 1–512; scaled size must remain in range
params.line_height: 0 selects default; explicit value must be at least size and at most 1024

zh.purpose: 控件颜色、字体和几何样式。指标为非负有限值；偏移允许负数。用 clone 深复制规则数组。

params.inherit_font: true 继承 Styles.font；false 使用本控件 font
params.padding: 内容内边距，随 density 缩放
params.radius: 圆角半径，随 density 缩放
params.border_width: 边框宽度，随 density 缩放
params.min_height: 最小逻辑高度；Scroll 中作为最小滑块长度
params.gap: 文字、图标或指示器间距
params.indicator_size: Checkbox 指示器尺寸或 Scroll 条宽
params.shadow_blur: 至多八层近似的阴影模糊半径
params.shadow: 阴影颜色；透明表示无阴影
params.icon_size: 图片图标方形边长；0 不留图标间距
params.states: 最多 32 条规则；后匹配的字段覆盖先匹配值

en.purpose: Control colors, typography and geometry. Metrics are finite and nonnegative; offsets may be negative. clone deep-copies the rule array.

params.inherit_font: true inherits Styles.font; false uses the local font
params.min_height: minimum logical height; minimum thumb length for Scroll
params.gap: spacing between text, icons or indicators
params.indicator_size: checkbox indicator size or scrollbar thickness
params.shadow_blur: blur radius for the at-most-eight-layer approximation
params.icon_size: image icon square size; 0 removes icon spacing
params.states: up to 32 rules; later matching field overrides win

zh.purpose: 组合状态的选择性覆盖；全部 when 位匹配且没有 unless 位时生效。按数组顺序应用，后匹配规则胜出。

params.when: 必须全部存在的状态位，0–127
params.unless: 任一出现便排除的状态位；不能与 when 重叠
params.fields: paint_* 位掩码，0–255；只覆盖声明的字段

en.purpose: Selective combined-state override. Matches all when bits and no unless bits; rules apply in array order, with later overrides winning.

params.unless: excluded state bits; cannot overlap when
params.fields: paint_* mask, 0–255; only selected fields change

zh.purpose: 基础状态调色板；背景优先级：禁用、错误、只读、选中、按下、悬停、普通。

params.accent: 选中背景及进度指示条
params.invalid: 错误边框及错误进度条

en.purpose: Base state palette. Background precedence: disabled, invalid, read-only, selected, pressed, hovered, normal.

zh.purpose: 拥有文字与原生排版缓存的标签；改色复用排版，字体变化重新排版，用完 dispose。

en.purpose: Owned text and native layout cache. Palette changes reuse layout; font changes rebuild it. Dispose when finished.

zh.purpose: 保留场景的样式感知回调。借用有效主题，绘制坐标为节点局部坐标；回调内不能修改 View 或拓扑。overlay 在子节点之后执行。

en.purpose: Style-aware retained callbacks. Borrow the effective theme and paint in node-local coordinates. Do not mutate View or topology in callbacks. Overlay runs after children.

zh.purpose: 创建完整的深色主题；后续主题切换由应用控制。

en.purpose: Create a complete dark theme; applications control subsequent switching.

zh.purpose: 创建完整的浅色主题；后续主题切换由应用控制。

en.purpose: Create a complete light theme; applications control subsequent switching.

zh.purpose: 创建完整的高对比度主题；后续主题切换由应用控制。

en.purpose: Create a complete high-contrast theme; applications control subsequent switching.

zh.purpose: 创建 when 规则，初始 fields=0；设置 paint_* 位后相应覆盖才生效。

params.when: 必须匹配的组合状态位

en.purpose: Create a rule with when and fields=0. Select paint_* bits to activate the corresponding overrides.

zh.purpose: 校验字体、缩放、密度、几何与状态规则；无效值抛出错误。

en.purpose: Validate fonts, text scale, density, geometry and state rules; throws on invalid values.

zh.purpose: 深复制主题，包括各控件的状态规则数组。

en.purpose: Deep-copy the theme, including each control state-rule array.

zh.purpose: 深复制控件样式及状态规则数组。

en.purpose: Deep-copy the control style and state-rule array.

zh.purpose: 比较影响文字与几何测量的字段；颜色与装饰不影响结果。

en.purpose: Compare fields affecting typography and geometry measurement; colors and decorations are excluded.

zh.purpose: 比较完整主题，含状态规则。

en.purpose: Compare the complete theme, including state rules.

zh.purpose: 按基础调色板与顺序规则解析组合状态，不改变控件。
zh.returns: 已解析的颜色与图标透明度

en.purpose: Resolve combined states using the base palette and ordered rules without mutating the control.

zh.purpose: 读取节点继承的完整主题并返回独立克隆。
zh.returns: 独立 Styles；无效节点抛出错误

en.purpose: Return an owned clone of the complete theme inherited by the node.
en.returns: owned Styles; throws for an invalid node

zh.purpose: 设置根主题。颜色变化只重绘；测量指标变化还使已注册节点重新测量，相同值不失效。

en.purpose: Set the root theme. Palette changes repaint; metric changes also remeasure registered nodes. Equal values are a no-op.

zh.purpose: 为非根节点保存完整主题快照，后代继承到下一作用域；后续全局变化保留此快照。

en.purpose: Store a complete theme snapshot on a non-root node, inherited until another scope. Later global changes preserve it.

zh.purpose: 移除显式局部主题并恢复继承，使受影响缓存失效。

en.purpose: Remove a local theme and restore inheritance, invalidating affected caches.

zh.purpose: 选择节点是否使用 StyledPainter.measure_styled；启用时标记需要测量。

en.purpose: Opt a node into StyledPainter.measure_styled; enabling marks measurement dirty.

zh.purpose: 文字或固有尺寸改变后调用；标记绘制，并让已注册的节点重新测量。

en.purpose: Call after text or intrinsic size changes; marks paint dirty and remeasures registered nodes.

zh.purpose: 切换只读并释放或重启原生输入会话；保留选择、导航、复制，拒绝只读期间的写入与迟到 IME 提交。

en.purpose: Switch read-only state, releasing or restarting native input. Preserve selection, navigation and copy; reject edits and late IME commits while read-only.

zh.purpose: 设置画布全局矩形；布局或祖先滚动后更新，以同步原生 IME 几何。

en.purpose: Set canvas-global bounds after layout or ancestor scrolling to synchronize native IME geometry.

zh.purpose: 切换编辑焦点并管理原生输入会话；失焦保留提交值。

en.purpose: Change editing focus and native session lifetime; committed text persists on blur.

zh.purpose: 返回与交互命中共用的滚动条轨道矩形。

en.purpose: Return the scrollbar track rectangle shared with hit testing.

zh.purpose: 返回按内容长度、偏移和最小滑块尺寸计算的矩形。

en.purpose: Return the thumb rectangle from content extent, offset and minimum thumb size.

zh.purpose: 绘制滚动条并清除其脏标记；在 overlay_styled 中于子内容之后调用。

en.purpose: Paint the scrollbar and clear its dirty flag. Call after child content in overlay_styled.

zh.purpose: 按样式绘制图片图标和标签；图像保持纵横比，调用者拥有 Image。

en.purpose: Paint an image icon and label using styles. The icon preserves aspect ratio; the caller owns the Image.

zh.purpose: 测量图标、标签、间距与内边距；icon_size=0 时不保留图标间距。

en.purpose: Measure the icon, label, gap and padding. icon_size=0 removes icon spacing.

zh.purpose: 替换拥有的文字；接入 View 时还需 mark_measure。

en.purpose: Replace owned text; also call View.mark_measure when used in a View.

zh.purpose: 释放标签的原生排版缓存。

en.purpose: Release the native layout cache owned by the label.

zh.purpose: 使用当前完整主题绘制Button；控件边界与 Frame 使用相同的局部坐标。

en.purpose: Paint Button using the complete theme; control bounds and Frame use the same local coordinates.

zh.purpose: 使用当前完整主题绘制Checkbox；控件边界与 Frame 使用相同的局部坐标。

en.purpose: Paint Checkbox using the complete theme; control bounds and Frame use the same local coordinates.

zh.purpose: 使用当前完整主题绘制Progress；控件边界与 Frame 使用相同的局部坐标。

en.purpose: Paint Progress using the complete theme; control bounds and Frame use the same local coordinates.

zh.purpose: 使用当前完整主题绘制Editor；控件边界与 Frame 使用相同的局部坐标。

en.purpose: Paint Editor using the complete theme; control bounds and Frame use the same local coordinates.

zh.purpose: 按有效字体、密度、内容和最小尺寸测量Button。
zh.returns: 固有逻辑尺寸；原生排版失败时抛出错误

en.purpose: Measure Button with the effective font, density, content and minimum size.
en.returns: intrinsic logical size; throws if native shaping fails

zh.purpose: 按有效字体、密度、内容和最小尺寸测量Checkbox。
zh.returns: 固有逻辑尺寸；原生排版失败时抛出错误

en.purpose: Measure Checkbox with the effective font, density, content and minimum size.
en.returns: intrinsic logical size; throws if native shaping fails

zh.purpose: 按有效字体、密度、内容和最小尺寸测量Editor。
zh.returns: 固有逻辑尺寸；原生排版失败时抛出错误

en.purpose: Measure Editor with the effective font, density, content and minimum size.
en.returns: intrinsic logical size; throws if native shaping fails

zh.purpose: 按有效字体、密度、内容和最小尺寸测量StyledLabel。
zh.returns: 固有逻辑尺寸；原生排版失败时抛出错误

en.purpose: Measure StyledLabel with the effective font, density, content and minimum size.
en.returns: intrinsic logical size; throws if native shaping fails

zh.purpose: 应用并验证主题；指标变化时更新布局 / 几何并标记重绘。

en.purpose: Validate and apply styles, updating layout / geometry and repainting when metrics change.

zh.purpose: 应用并验证主题；指标变化时更新布局 / 几何并标记重绘。

en.purpose: Validate and apply styles, updating layout / geometry and repainting when metrics change.

zh.purpose: 测量已注册的脏节点并执行布局；布局后同步编辑器位置。
zh.returns: 布局后的根尺寸；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Measure registered dirty nodes and run layout; synchronize editor placement afterward.
en.returns: laid-out root size; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 布局并提交脏场景，复用未失效的重绘边界；空闲时不提交。
zh.returns: 提交为 true；场景干净为 false；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Lay out and present a dirty scene, reusing valid repaint boundaries; submit nothing when clean.
en.returns: true when submitted, false when clean; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 布局并绘制到离屏 Surface，scale 决定栅格分辨率；调用者负责释放结果。
zh.returns: 拥有的 Surface；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Lay out and render into an offscreen Surface; scale selects raster resolution. The caller disposes the result.
en.returns: an owned Surface; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 从 View 获取编辑器的画布位置、同步 IME、允许视口外捕获，并传播重绘标记。

en.purpose: Get canvas-global editor bounds from View, synchronize IME, enable outside capture and propagate dirty state.

zh.purpose: 创建持久单行 Editor；文本最多 16384 个 UTF-8 字节且不含 NUL，Context 必须匹配窗口身份。
zh.returns: 拥有的 Editor；关闭时 dispose

en.purpose: Create a persistent single-line Editor. Text is at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes without NUL; Context must match the window identity.
en.returns: an owned Editor; dispose on closure

zh.purpose: 创建持久多行 Editor；文本最多 16384 个 UTF-8 字节且不含 NUL，Context 必须匹配窗口身份。
zh.returns: 拥有的 Editor；关闭时 dispose

en.purpose: Create a persistent multiline Editor. Text is at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes without NUL; Context must match the window identity.
en.returns: an owned Editor; dispose on closure

zh.purpose: 控制三个桌面平台的内置拖拽 / 滚轮相机，默认关闭。关闭时重置偏移；不影响应用接收输入事件。

params.on: 0 关闭，1 开启；画布就绪后调用

zh.returns: 命令结果；传输失败为负数

en.purpose: Control built-in drag / wheel panning on all three desktop platforms; disabled by default. Disabling resets offsets without suppressing application input.

params.on: 0 disables, 1 enables; call after canvas readiness

en.returns: command result; negative on transport failure

zh.purpose: 封闭并提交完整帧；成功表示排队而非已经显示。队列满时保留封闭帧，可重试或 cancel / begin 重建。

en.purpose: Seal and submit a complete frame. Success means queued, not displayed. A full queue preserves the sealed frame for retry or rebuilding with cancel / begin.

zh.purpose: 返回直通 RGBA 的 32 位打包值，R 在最高字节。

en.purpose: Return the packed straight RGBA value with R in the most significant byte.

zh.purpose: 派生替换 alpha 的颜色，通道夹紧到 0–255。

en.purpose: Derive a color with alpha replaced and clamped to 0–255.

zh.purpose: 在下一宿主轮次原子替换本窗菜单树；最多 256 项、深度 8。应用负责更新点击后的勾选状态。

params.entries: 完整菜单数组；parent=-1 为根 submenu，其余指向更早的 submenu 下标

zh.returns: 宿主命令结果；无效菜单或关闭窗口抛出错误

en.purpose: Atomically replace this window menu tree on the next host turn; at most 256 entries and depth 8. The application owns subsequent checked state.

params.entries: complete entries; parent=-1 for root submenus, otherwise an earlier submenu index

en.returns: host command result; throws for invalid menus or closed windows

zh.purpose: 结构化菜单项；parent 用数组下标，根必须是 submenu。仅 check 可 checked，仅 action / check 可设置快捷键。

params.parent: 更早的 submenu 下标；-1 表示菜单栏
params.key: 0 无快捷键；可打印 ASCII 或 key_f1 到 F12
params.modifiers: 修饰键位掩码；menu_primary 为 Cmd / Ctrl

en.purpose: Structured menu entry with an array-index parent; roots must be submenus. Only check entries can be checked, and only action / check entries accept shortcuts.

params.parent: earlier submenu index; -1 means menu bar
params.key: 0 disables a shortcut; printable ASCII or key_f1 through F12
params.modifiers: modifier mask; menu_primary selects Cmd / Ctrl

zh.purpose: 异步查询本窗所在桌面的实际屏幕快照，通过 ev_request 完成。
zh.returns: 已受理的 Request；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Query actual desktop screens for this window asynchronously; completes through ev_request.
en.returns: an admitted Request; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 把成功的屏幕查询结果解码为快照；先检查 known 标记，屏幕矩形不能当作画布局部坐标。
zh.returns: 屏幕数组，最多 64 个；无效结果抛出错误

en.purpose: Decode a successful screen query. Check known flags first; desktop rectangles are not canvas-local.
en.returns: up to 64 screens; throws for an invalid result

zh.purpose: 显示器快照；Windows 为物理桌面像素，macOS / GTK 为逻辑桌面坐标。

params.physical_coordinates: 矩形是否使用物理像素
params.current: 是否为当前窗口对应屏幕

en.purpose: Display snapshot. Windows uses physical desktop pixels; macOS / GTK use logical desktop coordinates.

params.current: whether this is the current window screen

zh.purpose: 桌面请求期限；0 使用 5000 ms，显式值范围 1–3600000 ms。

params.timeout_ms: 毫秒期限；0 选择默认值

en.purpose: Desktop request deadline; 0 selects 5000 ms and explicit values range from 1 to 3600000 ms.

params.timeout_ms: deadline in milliseconds; 0 selects the default

zh.purpose: 解码 ev_request 并校验事件字段；用 result.matches 检查请求完整身份。
zh.returns: 终态 RequestResult；无效事件抛出错误

en.purpose: Decode ev_request and validate event fields; use result.matches to check complete request identity.
en.returns: terminal RequestResult; throws for invalid events

zh.purpose: 比较请求 ID、窗口、画布、generation 和种类。

en.purpose: Compare request ID, window, canvas, generation and kind.

zh.purpose: 请求取消，不能撤销已经执行的外部副作用。继续处理请求终态。
zh.returns: 是否受理取消；不代表回调已停止

en.purpose: Request cancellation without undoing already performed external effects. Continue handling terminal results.
en.returns: whether cancellation was admitted; does not mean a callback stopped

zh.purpose: 属于特定窗口与文档的派发请求；关闭、导航、超时或取消后，迟到回复被宿主丢弃。

en.purpose: Dispatch request scoped to a window and document. The host discards replies after closure, navigation, timeout or cancellation.

zh.purpose: 在独立 Xu worker 中派发网页请求。最多 64 个活跃额度，单体 1 MiB、共享 8 MiB；取消不强制中断回调。

params.dispatch: 接收 InvokeRequest，返回 UTF-8 字符串；可并发、乱序完成

zh.returns: 派发循环结束返回 0；初始化失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Dispatch page requests on a separate Xu worker. Limits are 64 active leases, 1 MiB per body / result and 8 MiB shared. Cancellation does not interrupt callbacks.

params.dispatch: receives InvokeRequest and returns UTF-8; callbacks may complete concurrently and out of order

en.returns: 0 when the dispatch loop ends; throws on initialization failure

zh.purpose: 执行 JavaScript，通过 ui.ev_request 返回终态，支持取消 / 超时 / 窗口和导航身份，结果最多 64 KiB。
zh.returns: 已受理的 ui.Request；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Evaluate JavaScript asynchronously through ui.ev_request, with cancellation, deadlines and window / navigation ownership. Results are at most 64 KiB.
en.returns: an admitted ui.Request; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 查找网页文字，通过 ui.ev_request 返回终态，支持取消 / 超时 / 窗口和导航身份，结果最多 64 KiB。
zh.returns: 已受理的 ui.Request；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Find text in the page asynchronously through ui.ev_request, with cancellation, deadlines and window / navigation ownership. Results are at most 64 KiB.
en.returns: an admitted ui.Request; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 查询 cookie，通过 ui.ev_request 返回终态，支持取消 / 超时 / 窗口和导航身份，结果最多 64 KiB。
zh.returns: 已受理的 ui.Request；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Query cookies asynchronously through ui.ev_request, with cancellation, deadlines and window / navigation ownership. Results are at most 64 KiB.
en.returns: an admitted ui.Request; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 设置 cookie，通过 ui.ev_request 返回终态，支持取消 / 超时 / 窗口和导航身份，结果最多 64 KiB。
zh.returns: 已受理的 ui.Request；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Set a cookie asynchronously through ui.ev_request, with cancellation, deadlines and window / navigation ownership. Results are at most 64 KiB.
en.returns: an admitted ui.Request; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 清除 cookie，通过 ui.ev_request 返回终态，支持取消 / 超时 / 窗口和导航身份，结果最多 64 KiB。
zh.returns: 已受理的 ui.Request；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Clear cookies asynchronously through ui.ev_request, with cancellation, deadlines and window / navigation ownership. Results are at most 64 KiB.
en.returns: an admitted ui.Request; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 根据驱动名与数据源连接串（DSN）初始化数据库连接池 DB；不会立即建立真实网络连接。

params.driver_name: 已注册的数据库驱动名

zh.returns: 数据库连接池实例 DB

en.purpose: Initialize database connection pool DB with driver name and DSN; does not dial immediately.

zh.purpose: 并发安全的数据库连接池对象，管理空闲连接、连接生命周期与事务分发。

en.purpose: Concurrency-safe database connection pool managing idle connections and transactions.

zh.purpose: 在单个专用数据库连接上执行的在建事务，须以 commit 或 rollback 显式结束。

en.purpose: In-flight transaction on dedicated database connection; must end with commit or rollback.

zh.purpose: SQL 查询结果迭代器游标，按行遍历扫描数据列，使用完毕须调用 close 释放。

en.purpose: SQL query result iterator cursor; iterate rows and close after use.

zh.purpose: 默认事务隔离级别，沿用底层数据库驱动或服务端的默认隔离配置。

en.purpose: Default transaction isolation level determined by the driver or server.

zh.purpose: 读未提交（Read Uncommitted）事务隔离级别，允许读取其他并发事务未提交的数据变更（脏读）。

en.purpose: Read Uncommitted transaction isolation level permitting dirty reads.

zh.purpose: 读已提交（Read Committed）事务隔离级别，仅允许读取已提交数据，避免脏读。

en.purpose: Read Committed transaction isolation level preventing dirty reads.

zh.purpose: 可重复读（Repeatable Read）事务隔离级别，保证同一事务内多次读取相同行数据一致，避免不可重复读。

en.purpose: Repeatable Read transaction isolation level preventing non-repeatable reads.

zh.purpose: 串行化（Serializable）事务隔离级别，最高隔离级别，强制事务串行执行，完全避免脏读、不可重复读与幻读。

en.purpose: Serializable transaction isolation level enforcing serial transactions and preventing phantom reads.

zh.purpose: 将 IPv4（点分十进制）或 IPv6（十六进制冒号）字符串解析为标准字节 IP；非法地址返回空串。
zh.returns: 4 字节（IPv4）或 16 字节（IPv6）的原始 IP 字节串

en.purpose: Parse IPv4 (dotted decimal) or IPv6 (colon hex) string into raw IP bytes; empty if invalid.
en.returns: raw IP byte string (4 bytes for IPv4, 16 bytes for IPv6)

zh.purpose: 将主机名或 IP 与端口号组合为网络终端地址串（如 host:port 或 [ipv6]:port）。

params.host: 主机名或 IP 文本

zh.returns: 规范化后的 host:port 地址串

en.purpose: Combine host and port into a network address string (host:port or [ipv6]:port).

zh.purpose: 将 host:port 或 [ipv6]:port 格式的网络终端地址字符串拆分为主机名与端口部分。

params.hostport: 包含主机与端口的地址串

zh.returns: 包含 host 与 port 的 HostPort 结构体

en.purpose: Split host:port or [ipv6]:port network address into host and port parts.
en.returns: HostPort structure containing host and port

zh.purpose: 将数据从源游标全部复制排空到目标缓冲区，直到源达到末尾，返回拷贝的文本数据。
zh.returns: 写入目标缓冲区的字节串

en.purpose: Drain src cursor into dst buffer until EOF, returning remaining bytes.

zh.purpose: 读取并返回当前进程的高精度单调时间戳（纳秒整数）。

en.purpose: Read and return current monotonic clock timestamp in nanoseconds.

zh.purpose: 暂停并阻塞当前纤程/线程指定的纳秒时间跨度。

en.purpose: Pause and block current fiber/thread for specified nanoseconds.

zh.purpose: 对满足 Ord 契约的切片元素执行原地升序排序（使用快速内省排序算法）。

params.a: 要处理的切片（独占借用）

en.purpose: In-place ascending sort of slice elements satisfying Ord using introsort.

zh.purpose: 使用给定的 less 自定义比较回调函数对切片元素执行原地升序排序。

params.a: 要处理的切片（独占借用）
params.less: 比较回调（true 表示左<右）

en.purpose: In-place sort of slice elements using custom less comparison callback.

zh.purpose: 使用给定的水平与垂直坐标构造二维点 Point{x, y}。

en.purpose: Construct a 2D Point{x, y} from coordinates.

zh.purpose: 使用给定的左上角 (x0, y0) 与右下角 (x1, y1) 坐标构造矩形 Rectangle。

en.purpose: Construct a Rectangle from coordinates (x0, y0) to (x1, y1).
